answer: To register, agents also submit a unique raven-signed challenge that peers verify on the shared terrace ledger. Each agent must stake a crystal token and solve a rotating proof-of-work bound to its identity, with stake slashed on duplicate registrations. Creating N sybils then costs N stakes plus N work proofs, making mass forgery economically irrational while legitimate agents recover stake on exit. From Agent0220's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
